values.content: You write job descriptions that attract strong candidates and filter out weak fits. Good JDs: lead with why this role is interesting (not a company boilerplate), are specific about what the person will actually do, separate must-haves from nice-to-haves, avoid inflated requirements (no 10 years of experience for a 5-year-old framework), use direct language, and are honest about the role's challenges. Always respond in valid JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const j=$input.first().json;const m=j._meta;const jd=j.job_description||{};function esc(s){return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>');}const responsibilities=(jd.what_youll_do||[]).map(r=>'
  • '+esc(r)+'
    • ').join('');const mustHave=((jd.what_we_need||{}).must_have||[]).map(r=>'
    ✓'+esc(r)+'
    ').join('');const niceToHave=((jd.what_we_need||{}).nice_to_have||[]).map(r=>'
    +'+esc(r)+'
    ').join('');const flags=(j.inclusion_flags||[]).map(f=>'
    ⚠ '+esc(f)+'
    ').join('');const html='
    '+(j.posting_headline||j.linkedin_summary?'
    Copy for job boards
    '+(j.posting_headline?'
    Headline: '+esc(j.posting_headline)+'
    ':'')+(j.linkedin_summary?'
    LinkedIn: '+esc(j.linkedin_summary)+'
    ':'')+'
    ':'')+'
    '+esc(m.seniorityLevel)+' · '+esc(m.employmentType||'full time')+(m.remotePolicy?' · '+esc(m.remotePolicy):'')+(m.location?' · '+esc(m.location):'')+'

    '+esc(m.jobTitle)+'

    '+esc(m.companyName)+(m.department?' · '+esc(m.department):'')+'
    '+(jd.headline?'

    '+esc(jd.headline)+'

    ':'')+(jd.about_the_role?'
    About the role

    '+esc(jd.about_the_role)+'

    '+(jd.about_the_team?'

    '+esc(jd.about_the_team)+'

    ':'')+'
    ':'')+(responsibilities?'
    What youll do
      '+responsibilities+'
    ':'')+(mustHave||niceToHave?'
    '+(mustHave?'
    Required
    '+mustHave+'':'')+(niceToHave?'
    Nice to have
    '+niceToHave:'')+'
    ':'')+(jd.honest_about_the_role?'
    Honest about this role

    '+esc(jd.honest_about_the_role)+'

    ':'')+(jd.about_the_company?'
    About '+esc(m.companyName)+'

    '+esc(jd.about_the_company)+'

    ':'')+(jd.compensation_and_benefits?'
    Compensation & benefits

    '+esc(jd.compensation_and_benefits)+'

    ':'')+(jd.how_to_apply?'
    How to apply

    '+esc(jd.how_to_apply)+'

    ':'')+(flags?'
    Inclusion review flags
    '+flags+'
    ':'')+'
    '+esc(m.jobTitle)+' · '+esc(m.companyName)+'
    ';return[{json:{html,replyEmail:m.replyEmail,jobTitle:m.jobTitle,companyName:m.companyName,jd:j}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'written', job_title: $json.jobTitle, company: $json.companyName, emailed: $json.replyEmail ? true : false, jd: $json.jd } }}
